description: This file defines the SlimHttpServerRequestCreator class, which implements the ServerRequestCreatorInterface and is responsible for creating server request objects with decoration after checking for the decorator class's availability.

classes.name: SlimHttpServerRequestCreator
classes.description: A class responsible for creating decorated server request objects from global server variables.

methods.name: createServerRequestFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a decorated ServerRequest object from global server variables, throwing exceptions if decorators are unavailable or instantiation fails.

methods.name: isServerRequestDecoratorAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the server request decorator class is available in the environment.
